name: @qf-jarvis/api
description: QF Jarvis API application boundary. QFJ-S2-D-B (ADR-0064) makes this the process boundary that acquires the production Groq credential: a file-mounted backend implementing the existing GroqCredentialResolver, with an explicitly injected absolute path, lazy single-flight resolution, and a refreshable holder with last-known-good semantics. Reusable packages receive configuration explicitly and read no environment; only an executable process boundary acquires deployment configuration. This application reads no process.env, constructs no provider, opens no transport, and activates nothing.
